terrain.reason: No LOLA raster configured. Geometry uses a reference sphere; terrain obstruction is unknown.

provenance.orientation: NAIF pck00010 IAU_MOON (IAU 2009 low-precision lunar orientation)
assumptions: Planetocentric latitude; east-positive longitude; spherical lunar radius 1737.4 km.
Geometric body centers; no light time, stellar aberration, refraction, solar disk or Earth angular extent.
IAU_MOON is not a high-precision DE421 lunar principal-axis frame. Near-horizon mission decisions require a compatible binary lunar PCK and validated DEM frame alignment.
Availability uses left-endpoint samples weighted by interval duration. Transitions and blackout durations are uncertain by up to one sampling interval per boundary.
No terrain data means reference-sphere geometry only, not terrain clearance. Geometry is not power generation or guaranteed radio communication.
Sun/Earth directions use SPICE UTC-to-ET conversion; leap-second kernel is current through 2017. Future leap seconds are unknown.
Site coordinates are exploratory geographic references, not NASA-approved landing points.
